init.title: Configure Schulportal Hessen
init.description: Change the login credentials, school ID, child information, update interval, calendar event types, or active modules. For calendar event types: if the field is empty, all calendar event types are loaded. If types are entered, only those are kept. Multiple types may be separated by commas, semicolons, or line breaks. The integration will be reloaded automatically afterwards.
